high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from the website livescience.com. The article is titled "Physicists capture 'second sound' for the first time — after nearly 100 years of searching." It is written by Ben Turner and published yesterday. The content of the article discusses the discovery of "second sound," which is heat's wave-like flow through superfluids. This phenomenon was first theorized in 1938 but has been difficult to directly observe until now.
